items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are OUT vs Jaguars. Montgomery week-to-week.
items.why: No practice all week; explicit no-travel ruling from team/insiders. Schefter confirms Montgomery/Pitre.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks (workhorse snaps/touches expected); HOU passing volume up if Dell out; tough JAX run D limits ceiling.
items.opportunity: Marks near-100% snaps/carries/routes as seen post-injury Week 5 (98% snaps); Nico Collins/others more targets.
items.conflict: Berry hates Marks vs JAX elite run D despite volume.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs CAR due to a superficial blood clot in his calf; Tanner McKee will start. Status indefinite with further questions on timeline.
items.why: Blood clot confirmed; no travel/practice participation; Rapoport corroborates indefinite absence and McKee start.
items.implication: Eagles offense downgraded; McKee streamer/watch; boost to Goedert/Smith if active; Panthers DST upgrade.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining pass-catchers behind backup QB; lower team total.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder injury mid-TNF vs SEA, then confirmed returned to the game and ACTIVE.
items.why: In-game shoulder issue led to Q status; returned and finished.
items.implication: No lasting absence; but Berry already fading Waddle hard on season-long usage (most yards in one outlier game).
items.opportunity: Continued role if healthy; reverse any handcuff/beneficiary adds.
items.conflict: Berry HATE/WR28 on poor recent volume and SEA matchup.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day (hamstring), on track to start vs ATL.
items.why: Official injury report full participation; Rapoport notes working way back.
items.implication: Bears offense unlocked; start Williams with confidence in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for Odunze/Burden/Moore etc.; higher team total.

items.text: Lamar Jackson DNP again (ankle); real chance to return but monitor. Ashton Jeanty positive: feeling great, best of season per locker room comments.
items.why: Official DNP for Lamar; Jeanty self-report best health.
items.implication: Lamar GTD—have backup; Jeanty full go and potential breakout usage.
items.opportunity: If Lamar out, Likely/Flowers/Andrews more; Jeanty carries/routes secure.

items.text: Saquon Barkley DNP again (hamstring) per Schefter/Eagles report. Levitan: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz); Barkley turns 30 in Feb—if contender with RB need, call now.
items.why: Age/precedent + current hamstring DNPs; opportunity cost for contenders.
items.implication: Sell-high window if healthy short-term; monitor for multi-week or trade rumors. Eagles backs/gainwell upside if out.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps if inactive; long-term trade value drop.

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans as WR4 vs WAS; season-high 36% target share Week 5, and with Deebo Samuel out multi-week, Evans targeted >45% routes when Deebo off field. Commanders D buffet for pass-catchers.
items.why: Elite target share + Samuel absence + soft WAS secondary matchup.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 range; top-5 WR play this week.
items.opportunity: Expanded routes/targets/red-zone with thin depth chart behind him.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson out multi-weeks (high ankle). When inactive Week 1, Rhamondre Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches; >15 touches avg 16.3 PPG since 2024. Giddy up on volume.
items.why: Confirmed multi-week; prior full-workload data on Stevenson.
items.implication: Stevenson locked RB1/2 with bellcow role vs NYJ.

items.text: Breece Hall remains week-to-week, no practice. Levitan notes RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0—clear lead to Allen.
items.why: Snap data shows Allen dominating workload in Hall's absence.
items.implication: Allen is the clear every-down/handcuff starter and waiver priority while Hall out.
items.opportunity: Allen near-monopoly on carries/routes/snaps; start with confidence.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP second straight (hamstring); Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight (shoulder); Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight (ankle).
items.why: Consecutive DNPs raise OUT risk ahead of final reports.
items.implication: Rice out boosts Worthy/others; Moore limits BUF WR; Love absence to ARI backs.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups elevated snaps if ruled out.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), George Kittle (TE3 vs WAS), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WAS). Volume + soft matchups/leaking defenses.
items.why: Bankable usage (Kyren elite lately, Javonte GL, Stevenson volume post-Henderson, London role); WAS/others leak fantasy points.
items.implication: Strong start signals across positions; Purdy/Kittle stack vs WAS.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry shares in positive game scripts.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA; 67% season yards in one game, else ~16.5 ypg), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18), Woody Marks (RB22 vs JAX), JK Dobbins (RB27), Bo Nix (QB23), Justin Herbert (QB25). Ugly matchups + shaky QB/volume.
items.why: Poor recent usage (Waddle), tough defenses (SEA/PIT/JAX/KC), low team totals or scared play (Nix).
items.implication: Fade/sit; Marks volume real but matchup kills.
items.conflict: Marks volume post-Montgomery OUT conflicts with hate on matchup.

items.text: ETR/Levitan/Silva on MHJ trade to HOU: Kendrick Bourne expected more open targets than MHJ did in ARI. Jaylen Warren monster day as Rico Dowdle return looms; Jayden Daniels excellent return.
items.why: Trade opens ARI targets; Warren usage spike temporary vs Dowdle.
items.implication: Bourne/ARI WRs up; Warren start while Dowdle ramps; Daniels full go.
items.opportunity: Route/target share expansion in ARI; Warren carries if Dowdle limited.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (rookie) expected return to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; shot to play this weekend. Levitan: huge camp buzz, legit shot to ice Bateman; returns to elite YPP offense even sans full Lamar.
items.why: Surgery recovery on track + prior buzz + offense efficiency.
items.implication: Deep-league stash/waiver; potential immediate role if active.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in high-efficiency attack; monitor snaps.
